# Learning Journal Cycle Conventions

## Step Pipeline

| Step | Folder | Output |
|------|--------|--------|
| 0 | `Step-0-Temporal-Casting/` | Input-only scaffold (10 entries: P-5..P+5) |
| 1 | `Step-1-Polished-Notes/` | Date + Title + 3-7 sentence Summary + corrected body |
| 2 | `Step-2-Analytical-Study/` | Overview + outline + EML layer mapping + implications |
| 3 | `Step-3-Essays/` | Abstract + headed sections + EML links + Book Part + next-cycle directions |
| 4 | `Step-4-Study-Guides/` | Plain language key idea + 1-2 page reading + Reflect/Try prompts |
| 5 | `Step-5-Key-Ideas/` | Table: claim, commentary, Book Part, EML layer(s), status |
| 6 | `Step-6-Evaluations/` | 4 creative questions + evaluation table |
| 7 | `Step-7-Cast-Ahead/` | 5-day projection: Date + Prediction + Rationale |

## Operating Rules

- Steps 1-3 are the default engine (process every entry)
- Steps 4-6 are selective (when topic is active/central/recurrent)
- Step 7 is forward-casting (only when explicitly requested)
- Default: **one step per response**, clearly labelled

## Fidelity

- Steps 1-3: stay tightly faithful to handwriting
- Steps 4-7: may extend, but must note all extensions explicitly

## Tagging (Required for Step 2+)

Every output must include:
- **Book Part:** Orientation / Grammar / Circuits / Futures
- **EML Layer(s):** Structural / Cognitive-Temporal / Agentic

## Naming

Files: `YYYY-MM-DD-<short-descriptor>.md`

Keep filenames stable once cited in drafts.
